title: アドバンストロボティクス
subtitle: Advanced Robotics
keywords: Linear Regression and Classification 2.Kernel Regression 3.support Vector Machine 4.Gauss Process Regression 5.Model Learning and Learning Based Control
educationalGoal: Acquire the necessary knowledge of machine learning in robotics. Students will understand how to learn the motion of a robot in space from data and be able to use it for model learning and learning-based control. Students will learn linear regression and classification, polynomial regression, Gaussian kernel regression, and other kernel methods, as well as support vector machines and Gaussian process regression, and be able to use these methods in Python. Students will also acquire knowledge and skills for model learning and learning-based control.
advice: The student should understand the fundamentals of linear algebra and probability. It is also necessary to understand the fundamentals of system control (control engineering). Preparation for the next lecture will be given in class, and students are expected to check the contents of the lecture in advance. For review, solve the exercise reports (using Python) given in the class by yourself, and clarify any unclear points by the next class.
requiredKnowledge: The student should have an understanding of the fundamentals of linear algebra and probability. The student should also have an understanding of the fundamentals of system control (control engineering).
